Parent issue: #217

Stage: shared-route-catalog

## Task

Implement the durable follow-up for parent issue #217: introduce a shared route catalog/registry as the authoritative source for supported agent routes, including route id, prompt-facing description, target-kind constraints, explicit command support, label support where applicable, dispatch triage visibility, and approval/policy behavior as needed by existing code. Refactor triage route validation, explicit slash command parsing, label route mapping, and dispatch prompt consistency/rendering support to use the shared catalog instead of duplicated route lists where practical. Preserve existing behavior for answer, implement, fix-pr, review, create-action, unsupported, and the newly prompt-visible orchestrate route from PR #219. Keep GitHub Actions workflow job definitions explicit unless a small safe helper is already available; do not attempt a generic dynamic workflow dispatcher. Update focused tests so prompt route enumeration, JSON route union, supported ROUTES, explicit commands, and label-backed routes cannot drift silently. Update relevant docs if the source of route truth changes. Avoid unrelated route behavior changes.

## Base

- base_pr: #219
